chapterInfo.content:
12
Ahennie no mu paepae
1 # 2 Be 10 Na Rehoboam sii mu kɔɔ Sekem; na Sekem na Israel nyinaa aba sɛ wɔrebɛsi no hene. 2#1 Ah 11.40 Na Nebat ba Yeroboam teeɛ no, ɔno deɛ, (na ɔda so wɔ Misraim a ɔdwane firii Ɔhene Salomo anim kɔɔ hɔ no), na ɔte Misraim, 3na wɔsoma maa wɔkɔhyiaa no bae, na Yeroboam ne Israel asafo nyinaa baeɛ no, wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ Rehoboam sɛ: 4W’agya maa yɛn kɔnnua yɛɛ duru, na wo deɛ, afei yi w’agya ɔsom denden ne ne kɔnnua duruduro a ɔde too yɛn soɔ no so ma no nyɛ hare, na yɛnsom wo. 5Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monkɔ, na nnansa monsane mmra me nkyɛn. Na ɔman no kɔe.
6 # Mmb 12.5 Na Ɔhene Rehoboam ne mpanimfoɔ a n’agya Salomo da so te aseɛ no, na wɔyɛ n’afotufoɔ no tuu agyina sɛ: Ɛfoɔ bɛn na moretu me na mede mabua ɔman yi? 7Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ ɛnnɛ woyɛ akoa ma ɔman yi na wosom wɔn na wobua wɔn na woka wɔn asɛmpa a, ɛnneɛ wɔbɛyɛ wo nkoa nna nyinaa. 8Na ɔgyaa mpanimfoɔ fo a wɔtuu no no, na ɔne mmeranteɛ a wɔne no nyiniiɛ a wɔyɛ n’afotufoɔ no kɔtuu agyina, 9na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛfoɔ bɛn na mo nso motuo, na yɛde abua ɔman yi a wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Yi kɔnnua a w’agya de too yɛn kɔn soɔ no so ma no nyɛ hare, no? 10Na mmeranteɛ a wɔne no nyiniiɛ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sei na ka kyerɛ ɔman yi a wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ wo sɛ: W’agya maa yɛn kɔnnua yɛɛ duru, na wo deɛ, yɛ no hare ma yɛn no, sei na ka kyerɛ wɔn: Me kɔkorɔmmɔto so sene m’agya asene, 11na afei, m’agya de kɔnnua duruduro soaa mo, na me deɛ, mɛto mo kɔnnua no so; m’agya de mpire na ɛhwee mo, na me deɛ, mede anyanyankyerɛ#12.11 NYANYANKYERƐ: Yei yɛ aboa nwoma bi a wɔde nnadewa atuatua mu, a na wɔde hweɛ wɔ saa berɛ no mu a na ano yɛ ya pa ara. na ɛbɛhwe mo.
12 # 1 Ah 12.5 Na Yeroboam ne ɔman no nyinaa san baa Rehoboam nkyɛn da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, sɛdeɛ ɔhene kaeɛ sɛ: Da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, monsane mmra me nkyɛn, no. 13Na ɔhene de asɛmdenden buaa ɔman no, na ɔgyaa mpanimfoɔ no fo a wɔtuu no no, 14na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛdeɛ mmeranteɛ no tuu no foɔ no, sɛ: M’agya maa mo kɔnnua yɛɛ duru, na me deɛ, mɛto mo kɔnnua no so. M’agya de mpire na ɛhwee mo, na me deɛ, mede anyanyankyerɛ na ɛbɛhwe mo. 15#1 Ah 11.31 Na ɔhene antie ɔman no, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE na ɔdanee no saa, sɛ ɔbɛma n’asɛm a AWURADE nam Siloni Ahia so ka kyerɛɛ Nebat ba Yeroboam no aba mu.
16 # Mmb 15.1; 2 Sa 20.1 Na Israel nyinaa hunuu sɛ ɔhene antie wɔn no, ɔman no buaa ɔhene sɛ:
Kyɛfa bɛn na yɛwɔ no Dawid mu?
Yɛnni agyapadeɛ bi Yisai ba no mu,
monkɔ mo afie mu, Israel,
afei Dawid, hwɛ wo ara wo fie so.
Ɛnna Israel sii mu kɔɔ wɔn afie. 17Na Israelfoɔ a wɔtete Yuda nkuro mu no deɛ, Rehoboam dii wɔn so hene. 18Na Ɔhene Rehoboam somaa Adoram a ɔdi ɔhyɛ adwumayɛ toɔ soɔ no; na Israel nyinaa sii no aboɔ maa no wuiɛ. Ɛnna Ɔhene Rehoboam yɛɛ ntɛm faa teaseɛnam sɛ ɔredwane aba Yerusalem. 19Ɛno nti Israel wae firii Dawid fie ho de bɛsi nnɛ.
20Na Israel nyinaa tee sɛ Yeroboam asane aba no, wɔsoma maa wɔkɔhyiaa no baa asafo no mu, na wɔsii no Israel nyinaa so hene; obiara nni hɔ a ɔdii Dawid fie akyire sɛ Yuda abusuakuo nko.
21 # 2 Be 11.1-4 Na Rehoboam duruu Yerusalem no, ɔboaboaa Yuda fie nyinaa ne Benyamin abusuakuo ano, nnipa a wɔayi wɔn a wɔtu sa mpemha aduɔwɔtwe sɛ ɔne Israel fie rekɔko, na wɔadane ahennie no ama Salomo ba Rehoboam. 22Na Nyankopɔn asɛm baa Nyankopɔn nipa Semaia nkyɛn sɛ: 23Ka kyerɛ Salomo ba Rehoboam, Yuda hene, ne Yuda ne Benyamin fie nyinaa ne ɔman no nkaeɛ sɛ: 24Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Mommforo nnkɔ na mo ne mo nuanom Israel nnkɔko, monsane nkɔ mo afie; na me na asɛm yi firi me. Na wɔtiee AWURADE asɛm no, na wɔsane kɔe, sɛdeɛ AWURADE asɛm no seɛ no.
Yeroboam abosonsom
25 # Gye 32.31 Na Yeroboam kyekyeree Sekem, Efraim bepɔ so tenaa mu; na ɔfirii hɔ kɔkyekyeree Penuel. 26Na Yeroboam see n’akoma mu sɛ: Afei na ahennie no bɛsane akɔ Dawid fie, 27sɛ ɔman yi foro kɔbɔ afɔdeɛ AWURADE fie Yerusalem a, ɛnneɛ ɔman yi akoma bɛdane akɔ wɔn wura Rehoboam, Yuda hene nkyɛn, na wɔaku me, na wɔasane akɔ Yudahene Rehoboam nkyɛn. 28#Eks 32.4, 8 Na ɔhene no tuu agyina, na ɔyɛɛ sika nantwie mma mmienu, na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Moaforo akɔ Yerusalem bi ara! Israel, hwɛ wo anyame a ɔde wo firi Misraim baeɛ nie. 29#Ate 18.30 Na ɔde baako kɔsii Betel na ɔde baako nso kɔsii Dan. 30#1 Ah 14.16 Na asɛm yi danee bɔne, na ɔman no fa kɔɔ baako yi anim wɔ Dan, na baako no nso kɔɔ Betel. 31Na ɔyɛɛ sorɔnsorɔmmea fie, na ɔde ɔman no nyinaa mu nnipa a wɔmfiri Lewi mma mu sisii asɔfoɔ. 32Na Yeroboam hyɛɛ dapɔnna bosome a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe mu, bosome no da a ɛtɔ so dunum so, sɛ dapɔnna a wɔdi no Yuda no, na ɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ afɔrebukyia no so. Saa na ɔyɛɛ no Betel, ɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa nantwie mma a ɔyɛeɛ no, na ɔde sorɔnsorɔmmea a ɔyɛeɛ no asɔfoɔ duaa Betel. 33Na ɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ afɔrebukyia a ɔyɛɛ no Betel no so, bosome a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe da a ɛtɔ so dunum no so, bosome a ɔno nko ara bɔɔ ne tirim hyɛeɛ no mu, na ɔhyɛɛ dapɔnna maa Israelfoɔ, na ɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ afɔrebukyia no so, na ɔhyee aduhwam.

Na Rehoboam sii mu kɔɔ Sekem; na Sekem na Israel nyinaa aba sɛ wɔrebɛsi no hene. Na Nebat ba Yeroboam teeɛ no, ɔno deɛ, (na ɔda so wɔ Misraim a ɔdwane firii Ɔhene Salomo anim kɔɔ hɔ no), na ɔte Misraim, na wɔsoma maa wɔkɔhyiaa no bae, na Yeroboam ne Israel asafo nyinaa baeɛ no, wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ Rehoboam sɛ: W’agya maa yɛn kɔnnua yɛɛ duru, na wo deɛ, afei yi w’agya ɔsom denden ne ne kɔnnua duruduro a ɔde too yɛn soɔ no so ma no nyɛ hare, na yɛnsom wo. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monkɔ, na nnansa monsane mmra me nkyɛn. Na ɔman no kɔe.

Na Yeroboam ne ɔman no nyinaa san baa Rehoboam nkyɛn da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, sɛdeɛ ɔhene kaeɛ sɛ: Da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, monsane mmra me nkyɛn, no. Na ɔhene de asɛmdenden buaa ɔman no, na ɔgyaa mpanimfoɔ no fo a wɔtuu no no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛdeɛ mmeranteɛ no tuu no foɔ no, sɛ: M’agya maa mo kɔnnua yɛɛ duru, na me deɛ, mɛto mo kɔnnua no so. M’agya de mpire na ɛhwee mo, na me deɛ, mede anyanyankyerɛ na ɛbɛhwe mo. Yɛnni agyapadeɛ bi Yisai ba no mu,
monkɔ mo afie mu, Israel,
afei Dawid, hwɛ wo ara wo fie so.
Ɛnna Israel sii mu kɔɔ wɔn afie. Na Israelfoɔ a wɔtete Yuda nkuro mu no deɛ, Rehoboam dii wɔn so hene. Na Ɔhene Rehoboam somaa Adoram a ɔdi ɔhyɛ adwumayɛ toɔ soɔ no; na Israel nyinaa sii no aboɔ maa no wuiɛ. Ɛnna Ɔhene Rehoboam yɛɛ ntɛm faa teaseɛnam sɛ ɔredwane aba Yerusalem. Ɛno nti Israel wae firii Dawid fie ho de bɛsi nnɛ.

Na wɔtiee AWURADE asɛm no, na wɔsane kɔe, sɛdeɛ AWURADE asɛm no seɛ no.

Na Yeroboam kyekyeree Sekem, Efraim bepɔ so tenaa mu; na ɔfirii hɔ kɔkyekyeree Penuel. Na Yeroboam see n’akoma mu sɛ: Afei na ahennie no bɛsane akɔ Dawid fie, sɛ ɔman yi foro kɔbɔ afɔdeɛ AWURADE fie Yerusalem a, ɛnneɛ ɔman yi akoma bɛdane akɔ wɔn wura Rehoboam, Yuda hene nkyɛn, na wɔaku me, na wɔasane akɔ Yudahene Rehoboam nkyɛn. Na ɔde baako kɔsii Betel na ɔde baako nso kɔsii Dan. Na asɛm yi danee bɔne, na ɔman no fa kɔɔ baako yi anim wɔ Dan, na baako no nso kɔɔ Betel. Na ɔyɛɛ sorɔnsorɔmmea fie, na ɔde ɔman no nyinaa mu nnipa a wɔmfiri Lewi mma mu sisii asɔfoɔ. Na Yeroboam hyɛɛ dapɔnna bosome a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe mu, bosome no da a ɛtɔ so dunum so, sɛ dapɔnna a wɔdi no Yuda no, na ɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ afɔrebukyia no so. Saa na ɔyɛɛ no Betel, ɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa nantwie mma a ɔyɛeɛ no, na ɔde sorɔnsorɔmmea a ɔyɛeɛ no asɔfoɔ duaa Betel. Na ɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ afɔrebukyia a ɔyɛɛ no Betel no so, bosome a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe da a ɛtɔ so dunum no so, bosome a ɔno nko ara bɔɔ ne tirim hyɛeɛ no mu, na ɔhyɛɛ dapɔnna maa Israelfoɔ, na ɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ afɔrebukyia no so, na ɔhyee aduhwam.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
